name: SafetyBench
intro: SafetyBench是一个综合性的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型的安全性。它包含11,435个多项选择题，涵盖7个不同的安全问题类别。该基准测试同时包含中文和英文数据，支持两种语言的评估。
build_method: 已有数据转换, 考试题收集, ChatGPT扩增, 人工复核
eval_feature: 双语, 零样本, 少样本
intro_en: SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of large language models. It includes 11,435 multiple-choice questions covering seven different categories of safety issues. The benchmark contains both Chinese and English data, supporting evaluation in both languages.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SafetyBench arXiv:2309.07045 Sections 3-5 and Appendix; official thu-coai/SafetyBench repository. SafetyBench derives seven categories from eight typical safety scenarios, excluding sensitive topics because they diverge strongly across languages. It combines transformed public datasets, safety-related exams, and ChatGPT augmentation. Roughly 500 middle-school exam papers are OCR-processed and crowd-filtered to about 2,000 questions. Underrepresented categories gain about 3,500 ChatGPT questions, filtered by BLEU-4 similarity below 0.7 and manually checked. Questions are translated in both directions with the Baidu API, then all items receive human validation; GPT-4 agrees on 97% of a sample, disagreements are rechecked, and two authors plus a third adjudicator resolve issues. The final 11,435 bilingual MCQs are evaluated zero- and five-shot by parsed option accuracy, including category and language analysis.
